owner_and_capability: Fifth slice of #4076, Workforce and Shift-Plan-Sync: the Workforce postgres adapter, time tracking, planning, compose, legacy package and allowance stores, and the shift-plan-sync application no longer import Transaction Runtime's retained base model, foreign models/* or Delivery's realtimeevents. Not-found and unique-violation errors are recognised by marker and index name, planning reads schedules and templates through the Workforce capability, queues time-tracking events over realtime, records shift moves through its own audit port and reads room names through a Facilities directory the root binds.
affected_tables: None: no DDL or table ownership change.
atomic_cutover: Code cutover without a new rule or policy epoch. Workforce keeps its own Model, TenantModel and not-found sentinels with the RepositoryNotFound marker; repositories take Workforce's public filters; the allowance read-back stores read through the Workforce database runtime; the planning room port is RoomNamesByID bound by the root to Facilities; the substitution blockers use Workforce's own SubstitutionBlocker translated by the root. Suites read rows through local structs and public vocabulary; several adapter suites move to api. The weekly target helpers of models/config that Workforce replaced are deleted and their cases move to Workforce. Budgets only fall (workforce compose 7453 -> 7021, workforce legacy 730 -> 445).
tests: Workforce, Shift-Plan-Sync and moved api suites keep their assertions; the shift-move audit is asserted on the stored row in the series integration test.
scripts/run-go-toolchain.sh scripts/test-changed.sh origin/development without --fast; scripts/backend-architecture.sh check; validate-ticket --all.
